test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

**A place where aircraft are kept**
solution: The correct answer is: **Hangar**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Hangar"** refers to a large building used for housing and repairing aircraft. (विमान रखने और मरम्मत करने के लिए बड़ी इमारत) • **Example:** The airplane was moved to the hangar for maintenance after its last flight. • **"Aircraft" **means any vehicle that can fly, such as airplanes, helicopters, or drones. (वायुयान) • **Example:** The pilot skillfully landed the aircraft on the runway despite bad weather conditions. • Hence, we can conclude that a place where aircraft are kept is called a **"Hangar"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hangar**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Dockyard** (जहाज निर्माण स्थल): A place where ships are built, repaired, or docked. • **Example:** The dockyard was busy with workers repairing the large cargo ship. • **Depot** (गोदाम): A place for storing large quantities of goods or equipment. • **Example:** The train stopped at the depot to unload its cargo. • **Barracks** (सैनिक छावनी): A building or group of buildings used to house military personnel. • **Example:** The soldiers returned to the barracks after their training session. 4c:Ta39, The correct answer is: **Destitute**.
